messages:
rami.k (Sales): Team — Leo from Frontier told me their POC runs fine at low load but TTFT jumps and we hit intermittent 429s when they ramp for replay tests. Can we triage? :eyes:

leo.t (Customer): Repro at 14:00 UTC. Started with 30 concurrent tiny prompts, stepped to 120 over 5 minutes. Model: redwood/large-v1, no prefill. Request samples: f-20234, f-20235, f-20236.

anya.p (Solutions): Thanks Leo. Can you paste the client-side log around f-20235? Also are you using the JS SDK or direct REST?

leo.t (Customer): Using JS SDK. Log excerpt:

```
2026-03-21T14:02:12Z INFO req=f-20234 queued_ms=90
2026-03-21T14:02:12Z WARN req=f-20235 reason=queue_delay shard=s-9
2026-03-21T14:02:13Z ERROR req=f-20235 code=429 message=\"soft_ratelimit\"
```

drew.m (Oncall): That looks like shard soft limit. Two likely causes: bursty client concurrency causing batch windows to misalign, or KV cache hotset misses leading to CPU-bound tokens. Kai, do infra traces show KV miss burst?

kai.l (Runtime): Affirmative — s-9 had a spike in cache_miss_ratio and backend latency at 14:02. Also saw many half-filled batches due to affinity shuffling. Quick mitigations: (1) reduce peak concurrency and smooth the ramp, (2) enable prefix prefill for repeated prompt header, (3) tighten batch_window_ms to avoid long waits.

anya.p (Solutions): Leo, can you attempt a short A/B: keep total qps same but cap concurrency per client to 24 and set SDK prefetch=3. Also add prefill for the static system prompt you use.

leo.t (Customer): Will try. One commercial Q: if we recommend Dedicated for production, what's the onboarding time and price ballpark? Nina?

nina.a (Account): Dedicated onboarding takes ~3-5 business days for initial pool and network setup. Price depends on commit level; I'll share an outline. For short POC trials we can enable a 48-hour Dedicated trial at no charge for qualifying deals. I'll start a trial approval.

drew.m (Oncall): For immediate relief, SDK settings we usually advise: concurrency=24, prefetch=3, batch_max_tokens=200, batch_window_ms=18. If you use prefill, warm the KV by sending representative prompts before full load.

leo.t (Customer): Ran the cap to 24 and prefetch=3. New logs:

```
2026-03-21T14:06:05Z INFO req=f-20285 started first_byte_ms=112
2026-03-21T14:06:05Z INFO req=f-20286 started first_byte_ms=128
2026-03-21T14:06:06Z INFO req=f-20287 started first_byte_ms=360
```

kai.l (Runtime): Nice improvement on median, but that 360ms outlier hints at KV miss on that request's context. I'll schedule a targeted warmup on s-9 for those prompt prefixes. Also recommend enabling route-hint header X-Redwood-Prefer: low-latency to bias routing while we warm.

scale-bot: autoscaler checked shard s-9, concurrency high -> no additional capacity available (policy: bounded).

drew.m (Oncall): If warmup doesn't clear outliers, we can temporarily bump shard max_inflight for the POC cluster (ops approval needed). But first let Kai run the warmup and monitor 20 minutes.

kai.l (Runtime): Warmup job w-117 dispatched to s-9 (prefetch of 200 sample prefixes). ETA ~6m.

leo.t (Customer): Warmup started — will rerun replay after completion. Also security: Frontier asked about log retention and redaction options, any quick answer?

anya.p (Solutions): Hosted default log retention is 30 days with redaction options. We can enable PII redaction on ingestion and only export aggregated metrics. For stricter requirements we recommend Private deployment. Nina will follow up.

nina.a (Account): Confirmed. I'll attach the security addendum and the POC trial T&Cs in an email.

kai.l (Runtime): Warmup finished. Observed KV miss_rate drop from 17% -> 3% on s-9.

leo.t (Customer): Replay after warmup:

```
2026-03-21T14:14:40Z INFO req=f-20310 started first_byte_ms=96
2026-03-21T14:14:40Z INFO req=f-20311 started first_byte_ms=102
2026-03-21T14:14:41Z INFO req=f-20312 started first_byte_ms=120
```

drew.m (Oncall): That looks much cleaner. Action items: Kai to leave warm cache for 1 hour, Drew to watch for 429 regressions for next 60m, Anya to send SDK snippet and prefill how-to, Nina to email trial + security appendix, Rami to coordinate with Frontier on trial acceptance.

rami.k (Sales): Copy. Frontier interested in 48-hour Dedicated trial. Nina, please start the paperwork. Everyone thanks for the quick turnaround. :tada:

leo.t (Customer): Appreciate the speed. We'll report back if anything else pops up.
